concepts.title: Evaluating a Linear General Term of a Sequence
concepts.definition: Evaluating specific terms of a sequence by substituting the term index into the given algebraic formula for the general term.
concepts.key_idea: Substitute the term index into the explicit formula.
question_patterns: find the term of a sequence with general formula
calculate the nth term of a linear sequence
what is the term at index n for the sequence
determine the value of the term for a given formula
Explain the method of Evaluating a Linear General Term of a Sequence.

solution_steps.action: multiply coefficient by n
solution_steps.explain: Multiply the coefficient of the linear term by the term index n.

solution_steps.action: add the constant
solution_steps.explain: Add the constant term to the product to find the nth term.

solution_steps.action: verify the term matches the sequence formula at index n
solution_steps.explain: Confirm that substituting n into the general term formula yields the computed term value.

worked_examples.question: Solve a typical question involving evaluating a linear general term of a sequence.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: multiply coefficient by n. Step 2: add the constant. Step 3: verify the term matches the sequence formula at index n. Working: coefficient * n, term_product + constant, term_value.
worked_examples.answer: Evaluating a Linear General Term of a Sequence applied step by step gives the required result.

worked_examples.question: Apply evaluating a linear general term of a sequence to a fresh example and interpret the result.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: multiply coefficient by n. Step 2: add the constant. Step 3: verify the term matches the sequence formula at index n. Working: coefficient * n, term_product + constant, term_value.
worked_examples.answer: The method of evaluating a linear general term of a sequence leads to the required value or conclusion.

concepts.title: General Term of a Geometric Progression
concepts.definition: The nth term of a geometric progression is found by multiplying the first term by the common ratio raised to the power of one less than the term index.
concepts.key_idea: The general term of a G.P. is a_n = a * r^(n-1).
question_patterns: find the nth term of a geometric progression
calculate the term of a GP given first term and ratio
what is the general term of the geometric sequence
determine the value of the nth term in a GP
Explain the method of General Term of a Geometric Progression.

solution_steps.action: calculate the power of the common ratio
solution_steps.explain: The power is n - 1.

solution_steps.action: raise common ratio to the power
solution_steps.explain: Calculate common_ratio raised to (n - 1).

solution_steps.action: multiply by the first term
solution_steps.explain: Multiply the first term by the raised ratio to get the nth term.

worked_examples.question: Solve a typical question involving general term of a geometric progression.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: calculate the power of the common ratio. Step 2: raise common ratio to the power. Step 3: multiply by the first term. Working: n - 1, common_ratio ** power, first_term * ratio_power.
worked_examples.answer: General Term of a Geometric Progression applied step by step gives the required result.

worked_examples.question: Apply general term of a geometric progression to a fresh example and interpret the result.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: calculate the power of the common ratio. Step 2: raise common ratio to the power. Step 3: multiply by the first term. Working: n - 1, common_ratio ** power, first_term * ratio_power.
worked_examples.answer: The method of general term of a geometric progression leads to the required value or conclusion.

concepts.title: Sum of First n Terms of a Geometric Progression
concepts.definition: The sum of the first n terms of a geometric progression with a non-unity common ratio is calculated using the ratio of the difference of the nth power of the common ratio from one to the difference of the common ratio from one, multiplied by the first term.
concepts.key_idea: Summing a geometric series using the first term, common ratio, and number of terms.
question_patterns: find the sum of the first n terms of a GP
calculate the sum of a geometric series
what is the sum of a geometric progression up to n terms
determine the total sum of a GP
Explain the method of Sum of First n Terms of a Geometric Progression.

solution_steps.action: calculate the numerator of the ratio
solution_steps.explain: Raise the common ratio to the power of n and subtract 1.

solution_steps.action: calculate the denominator of the ratio
solution_steps.explain: Subtract 1 from the common ratio.

solution_steps.action: calculate the sum
solution_steps.explain: Multiply the first term by the numerator divided by the denominator.

worked_examples.question: Solve a typical question involving sum of first n terms of a geometric progression.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: calculate the numerator of the ratio. Step 2: calculate the denominator of the ratio. Step 3: calculate the sum. Working: (common_ratio ** n) - 1, common_ratio - 1, first_term * numerator / denominator.
worked_examples.answer: Sum of First n Terms of a Geometric Progression applied step by step gives the required result.

worked_examples.question: Apply sum of first n terms of a geometric progression to a fresh example and interpret the result.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: calculate the numerator of the ratio. Step 2: calculate the denominator of the ratio. Step 3: calculate the sum. Working: (common_ratio ** n) - 1, common_ratio - 1, first_term * numerator / denominator.
worked_examples.answer: The method of sum of first n terms of a geometric progression leads to the required value or conclusion.

concepts.title: Geometric Mean of Two Positive Numbers
concepts.definition: The geometric mean of two positive numbers is the square root of their product, forming a three-term geometric progression.
concepts.key_idea: Square root of the product of two positive numbers.
question_patterns: find the geometric mean of two numbers
calculate the GM of a and b
what is the geometric mean between two positive values
determine the geometric mean of
Explain the method of Geometric Mean of Two Positive Numbers.

solution_steps.action: multiply the two numbers
solution_steps.explain: Find the product of the two positive numbers a and b.

solution_steps.action: take the square root of the product
solution_steps.explain: The geometric mean is the square root of the product.

solution_steps.action: verify the mean forms a three-term geometric progression
solution_steps.explain: Confirm that a, G, b are in geometric progression with common ratio G / a equal to b / G.

worked_examples.question: Solve a typical question involving geometric mean of two positive numbers.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: multiply the two numbers. Step 2: take the square root of the product. Step 3: verify the mean forms a three-term geometric progression. Working: a * b, sqrt(product), geometric_mean.
worked_examples.answer: Geometric Mean of Two Positive Numbers applied step by step gives the required result.

worked_examples.question: Apply geometric mean of two positive numbers to a fresh example and interpret the result.

worked_examples.answer: The method of geometric mean of two positive numbers leads to the required value or conclusion.

concepts.title: Arithmetic Mean of Two Positive Numbers
concepts.definition: The arithmetic mean of two numbers is half of their sum, representing their average value.
question_patterns: find the arithmetic mean of two numbers
calculate the AM of a and b
what is the average of two positive numbers
determine the arithmetic mean between
Explain the method of Arithmetic Mean of Two Positive Numbers.

solution_steps.action: add the two numbers
solution_steps.explain: Find the sum of the two positive numbers a and b.

solution_steps.action: divide the sum by 2
solution_steps.explain: The arithmetic mean is half of the sum.

solution_steps.action: verify the mean lies midway between a and b
solution_steps.explain: Confirm that the arithmetic mean is equidistant from both a and b, satisfying the definition of an average.

worked_examples.question: Solve a typical question involving arithmetic mean of two positive numbers.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: add the two numbers. Step 2: divide the sum by 2. Step 3: verify the mean lies midway between a and b. Working: a + b, sum_val / 2, arithmetic_mean.
worked_examples.answer: Arithmetic Mean of Two Positive Numbers applied step by step gives the required result.

worked_examples.question: Apply arithmetic mean of two positive numbers to a fresh example and interpret the result.

worked_examples.answer: The method of arithmetic mean of two positive numbers leads to the required value or conclusion.

concepts.title: Relationship Between A.M. and G.M.
concepts.definition: For any two positive real numbers, their arithmetic mean is always greater than or equal to their geometric mean.
concepts.key_idea: The arithmetic mean of positive numbers is never less than their geometric mean.
question_patterns: verify that the AM is greater than or equal to the GM
show that the arithmetic mean exceeds or equals the geometric mean
prove the relationship between AM and GM for two numbers
is the arithmetic mean always larger than the geometric mean
Explain the method of Relationship Between A.M. and G.M.

solution_steps.action: calculate the arithmetic mean
solution_steps.explain: Find the arithmetic mean of the two numbers.

solution_steps.action: calculate the geometric mean
solution_steps.explain: Find the geometric mean of the two numbers.

solution_steps.action: compare the two means
solution_steps.explain: Verify that the arithmetic mean is greater than or equal to the geometric mean.

concepts.title: Common Ratio of a Geometric Progression
concepts.definition: The constant ratio obtained by dividing any term of a geometric progression by its immediately preceding term.
concepts.key_idea: Ratio of consecutive terms in a G.P.
question_patterns: find the common ratio of a geometric progression
calculate the ratio of a GP given consecutive terms
what is the common ratio of the sequence
determine the common ratio between terms
Explain the method of Common Ratio of a Geometric Progression.

solution_steps.action: divide the next term by the previous term
solution_steps.explain: The common ratio is the quotient of any term and its preceding term.

solution_steps.action: verify the ratio is constant across consecutive term pairs
solution_steps.explain: Check that dividing other consecutive terms yields the same common ratio, confirming a valid geometric progression.

solution_steps.action: confirm the ratio defines a valid geometric progression
solution_steps.explain: Ensure the common ratio is consistent throughout the sequence so each term is obtained by multiplying the previous term by r.

worked_examples.question: Solve a typical question involving common ratio of a geometric progression.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: divide the next term by the previous term. Step 2: verify the ratio is constant across consecutive term pairs. Step 3: confirm the ratio defines a valid geometric progression. Working: term_next / term_prev, term_next2 / term_next, common_ratio.
worked_examples.answer: Common Ratio of a Geometric Progression applied step by step gives the required result.

worked_examples.question: Apply common ratio of a geometric progression to a fresh example and interpret the result.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: divide the next term by the previous term. Step 2: verify the ratio is constant across consecutive term pairs. Step 3: confirm the ratio defines a valid geometric progression. Working: term_next / term_prev, term_next2 / term_next, common_ratio.
worked_examples.answer: The method of common ratio of a geometric progression leads to the required value or conclusion.

concepts.title: Common Ratio from Two Arbitrary Terms of a G.P.
concepts.definition: Finding the common ratio of a geometric progression when two arbitrary terms at different positions are known.
concepts.key_idea: The ratio of two terms a_q and a_p is r^(q-p).
question_patterns: find the common ratio of a GP from two non-consecutive terms
calculate the common ratio given the pth and qth terms
what is the common ratio when we know two arbitrary terms
determine the ratio of a GP from two given terms
Explain the method of Common Ratio from Two Arbitrary Terms of a G.P.

solution_steps.action: find the ratio of the two terms
solution_steps.explain: Divide the term at position q by the term at position p.

solution_steps.action: find the difference in their positions
solution_steps.explain: Subtract position p from position q.

solution_steps.action: calculate the reciprocal of the index difference
solution_steps.explain: Find 1 divided by the index difference.

solution_steps.action: calculate the common ratio
solution_steps.explain: Raise the term ratio to the power of the reciprocal of the index difference.

worked_examples.question: Solve a typical question involving common ratio from two arbitrary terms of a g.p..
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: find the ratio of the two terms. Step 2: find the difference in their positions. Step 3: calculate the reciprocal of the index difference. Step 4: calculate the common ratio. Working: term_q / term_p, q - p, 1 / index_diff, term_ratio ** power.
worked_examples.answer: Common Ratio from Two Arbitrary Terms of a G.P. applied step by step gives the required result.

worked_examples.question: Apply common ratio from two arbitrary terms of a g.p. to a fresh example and interpret the result.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: find the ratio of the two terms. Step 2: find the difference in their positions. Step 3: calculate the reciprocal of the index difference. Step 4: calculate the common ratio. Working: term_q / term_p, q - p, 1 / index_diff, term_ratio ** power.
worked_examples.answer: The method of common ratio from two arbitrary terms of a g.p. leads to the required value or conclusion.
